goal: FlowLab phase visual UI polish per PD stage. FlowLab (repo rtl-to-gds2-flow) is a Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + framer-motion teaching site for the RTL->GDSII physical design flow. Each of the 14 phases renders a per-stage visual kit: a bespoke animated SVG diagram (src/components/StageAnimation.tsx), a 4-step operational list and a teaching metrics bar chart (both driven by src/data/stageVisualMeta.ts and presented by src/components/StageVisualKit.tsx). Polish the per-stage visual UI specifically for the six Physical Design (PD) stages: floorplan (step 4, #f472b6), pdn (step 5, #e879f9), placement (step 6, #34d399), cts (step 7, #fbbf24), routing (step 8, #fb923c) and layout/Layout & Finishing (step 9, #2dd4bf; its SVG is the GDS2Animation). Polish means: make the six PD SVG diagrams more legible, technically faithful, visually richer and consistently styled (labels, legends, spacing, color use, motion) while keeping the existing StageAnimation prop contract and viewBox 0 0 400 220; and refine the PD-stage steps/detail copy and metrics chart data plus the shared visual-kit presentation so the steps cards and bar chart look crisp and readable. Do not regress non-PD stages, keep bilingual (loc(it,en)) strings, keep static export building, and keep eslint clean.
summary: polish the per-stage visual UI (SVG diagram + steps + metrics) for the six physical-design phases of FlowLab

No visual or functional regression on the eight non-PD stages.
Work ships as a single draft PR against main.

tasks.name: pd-stage-diagrams
tasks.scopedGoal: Polish the six Physical Design per-stage animated SVG diagrams in src/components/StageAnimation.tsx: FloorplanAnimation (floorplan), PDNAnimation (pdn), PlacementAnimation (placement), CTSAnimation (cts), RoutingAnimation (routing) and GDS2Animation (the layout/'Layout & Finishing' stage). Goal: make each diagram more legible, technically faithful and visually polished while keeping it recognizably the same concept. Concrete polish direction per diagram: (1) Floorplan - keep die/core/macros/power-ring but improve label legibility (avoid text overlapping the red power ring), add a small legend or clearer core-vs-macro distinction, tidy spacing. (2) PDN - clarify the bump->ring->strap->rail current path, consider subtle animated current-flow direction, ensure rails/straps/rings are visually distinguishable and the caption doesn't collide. (3) Placement - the timing-driven cell fill into rows; improve row/cell contrast and staggered motion, avoid cells overflowing the row band. (4) CTS - the clock H-tree; make the buffer levels and leaf endpoints clearer, keep the pulse animation but ensure branches read as a balanced tree. (5) Routing - multi-layer metal routes; fix the via dots which are currently rendered at cx=0,cy=0 (they do not sit on the route bends) so vias actually land on path vertices, and make the M1..M5 layer legend consistent with the route colors. (6) GDS2/layout - the layer stack + die; improve layer label legibility and stacking, keep 'design.gds' caption. Constraints: DO NOT change the StageAnimation export signature or the switch/case wiring; keep every animation's prop contract ({ color }: { color: string }) and the SVG viewBox '0 0 400 220'; keep it a client component with framer-motion; prefer whileInView with viewport once:true for entrance and keep any looping motion subtle. You MAY add CSS @keyframes/utility classes to src/app/globals.css if a diagram needs new named animation, but do not remove or rename existing keyframes/utilities (flow-dash, float, pulse-glow, scan-line, fade-up, .glass) that other components rely on. Only touch the six PD animations plus shared defs you add; do not alter the eight non-PD animation functions except trivially-shared <defs> you introduce. Run `npm install` then `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; both must pass before you hand off.
acceptance: All six PD SVG diagrams (floorplan, pdn, placement, cts, routing, layout/GDS2) are visibly polished and more legible.
Routing via dots are positioned on actual route vertices (not at 0,0).
StageAnimation export signature, switch/case wiring, per-animation {color} prop contract, and viewBox 0 0 400 220 are unchanged.
No existing globals.css keyframe/utility (flow-dash, float, pulse-glow, scan-line, fade-up, .glass) is removed or renamed.

tasks.name: integrate-pd-visuals
tasks.scopedGoal: Integrate the two upstream PD-visual-polish branches into one deliverable branch and open a draft PR. Two upstream handoffs are included above in this prompt; each has a '## Branch' line naming the branch to merge (one for pd-stage-diagrams touching src/components/StageAnimation.tsx and src/app/globals.css, one for pd-stage-metrics touching src/data/stageVisualMeta.ts and src/components/StageVisualKit.tsx). Steps: (1) Read both '## Branch' lines. (2) From your current branch (cloned from main), run `git fetch origin <diagrams-branch> <metrics-branch>` then `git merge --no-ff` each of the two branches into your current branch. The two changes touch DISJOINT files so no conflicts are expected; if a conflict does arise, preserve BOTH sides' intent (never drop one worker's changes). (3) Run `npm install`, then `npm run build` (must succeed - static export) and `npm run lint` (must be clean); fix any integration breakage. (4) Commit and push your branch. (5) Open a DRAFT pull request against main via the ManagePullRequest tool titled something like 'Polish per-PD-stage visual UI (diagrams + metrics)' with a body summarizing the diagram and metrics/kit polish for floorplan, pdn, placement, cts, routing and layout, and noting that non-PD stages are unchanged. Do not merge the PR.
